# Karl Mayr GmbH & Co. KG — Full Reference

> Master craftsman roofing, metalwork, and glazing company in Saalfelden am Steinernen Meer, Pinzgau, Salzburg, Austria. Serving residential, commercial, and public clients since 1972.

## About the Company

Karl Mayr GmbH & Co. KG is a family-owned construction company specializing in building envelope solutions. Founded in 1972 in Saalfelden am Steinernen Meer, the company has grown to become one of the leading roofing and facade specialists in the Pinzgau region and greater Salzburg area.

With 49 employees, 3 certified master craftsmen (Meister), and a fleet of 36 vehicles, the company handles over 100 projects per year. Their expertise spans six core disciplines: roofing, metalwork/tinsmithing, glazing, facade construction, waterproofing/sealing, and green roof systems.

The company is registered at the Landesgericht Salzburg (register number 27952g) with UID ATU 33653702. They hold trade certifications for Dachdecker (Roofer), Spengler (Tinsmith), and Glaser (Glazier), and are members of the Innung der Dachdecker und Spengler (Roofers and Tinsmiths Guild).

## Detailed Services

### Dachdeckerei (Roofing)
Karl Mayr provides comprehensive roofing services for all building types. This includes new roof construction, complete roof renovations, emergency repairs, and regular maintenance programs. They work with all common roofing materials including clay tiles, concrete tiles, metal roofing, slate, and flat roof membranes. Their roofing expertise covers pitched roofs, flat roofs, mansard roofs, and specialty architectural roofing. As a certified master craftsman operation (Meisterbetrieb), they guarantee quality workmanship that meets all Austrian building codes and standards.

### Spenglerei (Metalwork / Tinsmithing)
The metalwork division handles all sheet metal work related to building envelopes. Services include custom gutter systems, downspouts, flashings, chimney cladding, dormer cladding, metal roof panels, standing seam roofing, and decorative copper work. They work with zinc, copper, aluminum, stainless steel, and coated steel. Custom fabrication is done in their own workshop.

### Glaserei (Glazing)
The glazing department provides glass installation services including window glazing, insulated glass units, glass facades and curtain walls, glass railings and balustrades, shower enclosures, mirrors, decorative glass, and safety/security glass installations. They handle both residential and commercial glazing projects.

### Fassade (Facade Construction)
Facade services include exterior insulation and finish systems (ETICS/WDVS), ventilated facades, panel cladding, facade renovation and restoration, and thermal insulation upgrades. They work with various cladding materials including fiber cement, metal panels, wood, and composite materials.

### Abdichtungsarbeiten (Sealing / Waterproofing)
Waterproofing services cover basement and foundation sealing, flat roof waterproofing, balcony and terrace sealing, wet room sealing, and remediation of water damage. They use modern bituminous and synthetic membrane systems.

### Gründächer (Green Roofs)
Green roof services include both extensive systems (low-maintenance sedum/moss roofs) and intensive systems (rooftop gardens with deeper soil and diverse planting). They handle the complete system from root barrier and drainage layers to growing medium and planting. Green roofs provide thermal insulation, stormwater management, and biodiversity benefits.

## Careers

Karl Mayr regularly offers positions for skilled roofers, tinsmiths, glaziers, and apprentices. They provide apprenticeship training (Lehre) in roofing and tinsmithing trades. Job listings and an online application form are available at https://mayr-dach.com/jobs.
